summary.description: Two to four sentences: what was reviewed and the overall verdict.

category.description: One kebab-case word or two, such as correctness, security, error-handling, spec-violation, test-gap, performance, maintainability.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file the finding is in.

line.description: 1-based line number in the reviewed (new) version of the file. Prefer a line inside a changed hunk.

title.description: One line, at most 80 characters: the defect, not the fix.

body.description: The evidence (cite the code), a concrete failure scenario, and a suggested fix. Markdown.
